description: Original KEA FDA-level Communication Paper mock test. 100 MCQs, 100 marks, 120 minutes. Practice blueprint: General Kannada 35 questions, General English 35 questions, Computer Knowledge 30 questions. Questions are newly authored and are not copied from the user's uploaded starter question bank. Suggested marking practice: +1 for correct, -0.25 for incorrect; follow the current official notification for the actual examination.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಮಹಾ + ಇಂದ್ರ' ಎಂಬ ಪದಗಳು ಸಂಧಿಯಾದಾಗ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ರೂಪ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ಆ + ಇ ಸೇರಿ ಏ ಆಗುವುದರಿಂದ 'ಮಹೇಂದ್ರ' ಎಂಬ ರೂಪ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ರಾಜಪುತ್ರ' ಎಂಬ ಪದದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಸಮಾಸದ ಪ್ರಕಾರವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ.
questions.explanation: ರಾಜನ ಪುತ್ರ ಎಂಬ ಷಷ್ಠೀ ತತ್ಪುರುಷ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡಕವಾಗಿದೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಮರದಿಂದ ಹಣ್ಣು ಬಿತ್ತು' ಎಂಬ ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ 'ಮರದಿಂದ' ಪದವು ಯಾವ ವಿಭಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: 'ಇಂದ/ದಿಂದ' ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯವು ಕರಣ ಅಥವಾ ಅಪಾದಾನಾರ್ಥಕ ತೃತೀಯಾ ವಿಭಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಓದಿದ ಪುಸ್ತಕ' ಎಂಬ ಪದಗುಚ್ಛದಲ್ಲಿ 'ಓದಿದ' ಯಾವ ರೂಪಕ್ಕೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆ?
questions.explanation: ಧಾತುವಿಗೆ ಕೃತ್ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ ಸೇರಿ ರೂಪುಗೊಂಡ 'ಓದಿದ' ಕೃದಂತ ರೂಪವಾಗಿದೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಮಾನವೀಯ' ಎಂಬ ಪದದಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತವಾಗಿರುವ ತದ್ಧಿತಾರ್ಥ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: 'ಮಾನವ' ಪದದಿಂದ 'ಮಾನವೀಯ' ಎಂಬ ಗುಣ ಅಥವಾ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಸೂಚಕ ರೂಪ ಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿದೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಅವಳು ಬಹಳ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಮಾತನಾಡಿದಳು' ಎಂಬ ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ 'ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ' ಯಾವ ಪದವರ್ಗಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿದೆ?
questions.explanation: 'ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ' ಮಾತನಾಡುವ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ರೀತಿಯನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುವ ಕ್ರಿಯಾವಿಶೇಷಣ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಮಳೆ ಬಂದರೆ ಬೆಳೆ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ' ಎಂಬುದು ರಚನೆಯ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಯಾವ ವಾಕ್ಯ?
questions.explanation: ಒಂದು ಅವಲಂಬಿತ ಷರತ್ತು ವಾಕ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಧಾನ ವಾಕ್ಯ ಇರುವುದರಿಂದ ಇದು ಮಿಶ್ರ ವಾಕ್ಯ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಅಗ್ನಿ' ಪದಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊಂದುವ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: 'ಬೆಂಕಿ' ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ; ಉಳಿದವು ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ ಮೂಲದ ಸಮಾನಾರ್ಥಕ ಪದಗಳು.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಪಯೋಧಿ' ಪದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮಾನಾರ್ಥಕ ಪದ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: 'ಪಯೋಧಿ' ಎಂದರೆ ನೀರನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವುದು; ಸಮುದ್ರ ಎಂಬ ಅರ್ಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಉತ್ಕರ್ಷ' ಪದದ ವಿರುದ್ಧಾರ್ಥಕ ಪದವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ.
questions.explanation: ಉತ್ಕರ್ಷ ಎಂದರೆ ಏಳಿಗೆ; ಅವನತಿ ಅದರ ವಿರುದ್ಧಾರ್ಥ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಅಂಕ' ಪದವು ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಯಾವ ಅರ್ಥಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗಬಹುದು?
questions.explanation: 'ಅಂಕ' ಪದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ, ಮಡಿಲು, ನಾಟಕದ ಅಂಕ ಮುಂತಾದ ಹಲವು ಅರ್ಥಗಳಿವೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಕೈಚೆಲ್ಲು' ಎಂಬ ನುಡಿಗಟ್ಟಿನ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಅರ್ಥ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ಕೈಚೆಲ್ಲು ಎಂದರೆ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಅಥವಾ ಭರವಸೆಯನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟುಬಿಡುವುದು.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಹಾಸಿಗೆ ಇದ್ದಷ್ಟು ಕಾಲು ಚಾಚು' ಎಂಬ ಗಾದೆಯ ಆಶಯ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುವ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಅನುಗುಣವಾಗಿ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸಬೇಕು ಎಂಬುದು ಗಾದೆಯ ಆಶಯ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಅವಳ ಮುಖ ಚಂದ್ರನಂತೆ ಹೊಳೆಯಿತು' ಎಂಬ ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವ ಅಲಂಕಾರವಿದೆ?
questions.explanation: 'ಹಾಗೆ/ಅಂತೆ' ಎಂಬ ಹೋಲಿಕೆಯ ಸೂಚಕದ ಮೂಲಕ ಹೋಲಿಸಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಉಪಮಾಲಂಕಾರ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: ಕನ್ನಡ ಛಂದಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಮಾತ್ರೆಯ ಕಾಲಮೌಲ್ಯ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಅಕ್ಷರವನ್ನು ಏನೆಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ?
questions.explanation: ಒಂದು ಮಾತ್ರೆಯ ಕಾಲಮೌಲ್ಯವುಳ್ಳ ಅಕ್ಷರ ಲಘು; ಎರಡು ಮಾತ್ರೆಯದು ಗುರು.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಕವಯಿತ್ರಿ' ಪದವು ಯಾವ ಲಿಂಗವನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: ಕವಯಿತ್ರಿ ಎಂಬುದು ಸ್ತ್ರೀ ಕವಿಯನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುವ ಸ್ತ್ರೀಲಿಂಗ ಪದ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಮಕ್ಕಳು' ಪದದ ಏಕವಚನ ರೂಪ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: 'ಮಗು' ಏಕವಚನ; 'ಮಕ್ಕಳು' ಅದರ ಬಹುವಚನ ರೂಪ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ನಾವು ನಾಳೆ ಸಭೆಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತೇವೆ' ಎಂಬ ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿನ ಸರ್ವನಾಮ ಯಾವ ಪುರುಷಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿದೆ?
questions.explanation: ಮಾತನಾಡುವವರನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡ 'ನಾವು' ಉತ್ತಮ ಪುರುಷ ಸರ್ವನಾಮ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಅವರು ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದಿದ್ದರು' ಎಂಬ ಕ್ರಿಯಾರೂಪವು ಯಾವ ಕಾಲವನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: 'ಬರೆದಿದ್ದರು' ಎಂಬ ರೂಪವು ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಭೂತಕಾಲದ ಸಂದರ್ಭಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಮುಂಚೆ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಂಡ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಮನೆತನ' ಪದದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿರುವ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: 'ಮನೆ' ಪದಕ್ಕೆ 'ತನ' ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ ಸೇರಿ ಮನೆತನ ಎಂಬ ಭಾವವಾಚಕ ನಾಮಪದ ರೂಪುಗೊಂಡಿದೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: ಕೆಳಗಿನವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮುಚ್ಚಯಾರ್ಥಕ ಅವ್ಯಯ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: 'ಮತ್ತು' ಎರಡು ಪದಗಳು ಅಥವಾ ವಾಕ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುವ ಸಮುಚ್ಚಯಾರ್ಥಕ ಅವ್ಯಯ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: ಕೆಳಗಿನವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಶುದ್ಧವಾಗಿ ಬರೆದಿರುವ ಪದ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: 'ಔದಾರ್ಯ' ಎಂಬುದೇ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಶುದ್ಧಲೇಖನ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: ವ್ಯಾಕರಣದ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ವಾಕ್ಯವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ.
questions.explanation: ಬಹುವಚನ ಕರ್ತೃಸಮೂಹಕ್ಕೆ ಅನುಗುಣವಾಗಿ 'ಬರುತ್ತೇವೆ' ಎಂಬ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಪದ ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗಬೇಕು.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಗುರುವು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗೆ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಕೊಟ್ಟರು' ಎಂಬ ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ 'ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗೆ' ಯಾವ ಕಾರಕವನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: ಯಾರಿಗೆ ನೀಡಲಾಯಿತು ಎಂಬ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸುವವನನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಸಂಪ್ರದಾನ ಕಾರಕ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಅವನ ಮಾತುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಂಗ್ಯವಿತ್ತು' ಎಂಬ ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ 'ವ್ಯಂಗ್ಯ' ಪದದ ಅರ್ಥ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ವ್ಯಂಗ್ಯ ಎಂದರೆ ಪರೋಕ್ಷವಾಗಿ ಟೀಕಿಸುವ ಅಥವಾ ಚುಚ್ಚುವ ಮಾತು.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಲೋಕ + ಉಪಕಾರ' ಪದಗಳು ಸೇರಿ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಸರಿಯಾದ ರೂಪ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ಅ + ಉ ಸೇರಿ ಓ ಆಗುವ ಗುಣಸಂಧಿಯಿಂದ 'ಲೋಕೋಪಕಾರ' ರೂಪ ಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ನೀಲಕಂಠ' ಎಂಬುದು ಶಿವನನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುವಾಗ ಯಾವ ಸಮಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆ?
questions.explanation: ನೀಲವಾದ ಕಂಠವುಳ್ಳವನು ಎಂಬ ಬಾಹ್ಯಾರ್ಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿವನನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಬಹುವ್ರೀಹಿ ಸಮಾಸ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಯಾರು ಶ್ರಮಿಸುತ್ತಾರೋ ಅವರು ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ' ಎಂಬ ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ 'ಯಾರು' ಯಾವ ವಿಧದ ಸರ್ವನಾಮ?
questions.explanation: 'ಯಾರು-ಅವರು' ಎಂಬ ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಬಂಧವಾಚಕ ಬಳಕೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಬಾಗಿಲನ್ನು ಮುಚ್ಚಿರಿ' ಎಂಬ ವಾಕ್ಯವು ಯಾವ ವಿಧಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿದೆ?
questions.explanation: ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಮಾಡಲು ಸೂಚನೆ ಅಥವಾ ಆಜ್ಞೆ ನೀಡುವುದರಿಂದ ಆಜ್ಞಾರ್ಥಕ ವಾಕ್ಯ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಮೂಗಿಗೆ ತುಪ್ಪ ಸವರು' ಎಂಬ ನುಡಿಗಟ್ಟಿನ ಅರ್ಥ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ಈ ನುಡಿಗಟ್ಟು ಮೋಸಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಅಥವಾ ಸುಳ್ಳು ಭರವಸೆ ನೀಡಿ ನಂಬಿಸುವುದನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ವಚನ' ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಲಕ್ಷಣ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ವಚನಗಳು ಸರಳ ಗದ್ಯಲಯದ, ಅನುಭವ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ-ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಚಿಂತನೆ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಅಭಿವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳು.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: ಕನ್ನಡದ ಆದಿಕವಿ ಎಂದು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಯಾರನ್ನು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ?
questions.explanation: ಪಂಪನನ್ನು ಕನ್ನಡದ ಆದಿಕವಿ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: ನವೋದಯ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಲಕ್ಷಣ ಯಾವುದು?

options.B: ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯತೆ, ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಪ್ರೇಮ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನವತಾವಾದಿ ಭಾವನೆಗಳ ಅಭಿವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ

questions.explanation: ನವೋದಯ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಜಾಗೃತಿ, ಪ್ರಕೃತಿ, ಮಾನವೀಯತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹೊಸ ಕಾವ್ಯಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆ ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾಗಿವೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಸಮಯವನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸುವುದು ಎಂದರೆ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ತ್ವರಿತವಾಗಿ ಮುಗಿಸುವುದಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ; ಅಗತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲದ ಕೆಲಸಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ ಅವನ್ನು ಕೈಬಿಡುವುದೂ ಹೌದು.' ಈ ವಾಕ್ಯದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಆಶಯ ಯಾವುದು?

options.B: ಸಮಯ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಗೆ ಆದ್ಯತೆ ನಿಗದಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅನಗತ್ಯ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳ ತ್ಯಜನೆ ಅಗತ್ಯ

questions.explanation: ವಾಕ್ಯವು ಸಮಯ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆದ್ಯತೆ ನಿಗದಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅನಗತ್ಯ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಡುವ ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಿಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Neither the manager nor the assistants _____ aware of the revised schedule.
questions.explanation: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject; 'assistants' is plural.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: By the time the committee arrived, the secretary _____ the minutes.
questions.explanation: The preparation was completed before another past event; past perfect is required.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: If the applicant _____ the documents earlier, the application would not have been rejected.
questions.explanation: This is a third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + past participle.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: She was appointed _____ honorary secretary of the association.
questions.explanation: No article is normally used before a complement such as 'appointed honorary secretary'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: The new policy is aimed _____ improving access to public services.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is 'aimed at + gerund/noun'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Choose the correct passive form: 'They have postponed the interview.'

options.A: The interview had been postponed by them.

questions.explanation: Present perfect active changes to present perfect passive: has been + past participle.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: He said, 'I have been waiting here for two hours.' Choose the correct reported form.

options.A: He said that he has been waiting there for two hours.
options.B: He said that he had been waiting there for two hours.
options.C: He said that I had waited here for two hours.
options.D: He said that he was waiting here since two hours.

questions.explanation: Backshift changes present perfect continuous to past perfect continuous; 'here' changes to 'there'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Each of the candidates must bring _____ own identity card.
questions.explanation: In formal traditional agreement, 'each' is singular and takes 'his or her'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Choose the sentence with the correct placement of the modifier.

options.A: Walking through the corridor, the notice board caught my attention.
options.B: Walking through the corridor, I noticed the notice board.
options.C: The notice board, walking through the corridor, caught my attention.
options.D: I noticed, walking through the corridor, by the notice board.

questions.explanation: The introductory participial phrase must modify the subject 'I', not 'notice board'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Choose the sentence that maintains parallel structure.

options.A: The role requires drafting reports, to analyse data and presentations.
options.B: The role requires drafting reports, analysing data and preparing presentations.
options.C: The role requires to draft reports, analysing data and presentations.
options.D: The role requires drafting reports, data analysis and to prepare presentations.

questions.explanation: All three items use parallel gerund forms: drafting, analysing and preparing.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Choose the closest meaning of 'mitigate'.
questions.explanation: Mitigate means to make something less severe or harmful; alleviate is closest.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Choose the antonym of 'explicit'.
questions.explanation: Explicit means clearly stated; implicit means implied rather than directly expressed.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: A person who can use both hands with equal skill is called _____ .
questions.explanation: Ambidextrous describes the ability to use both hands equally well.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Choose the correct word: The new rules will _____ all departments equally.
questions.explanation: Affect is the verb meaning to influence; effect is usually a noun.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: The meeting was _____ because the chairperson was unwell.
questions.explanation: 'Put off' means to postpone.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: The phrase 'to leave no stone unturned' means to _____ .
questions.explanation: The idiom means to try every possible method to achieve something.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Few candidates understood the instruction, _____?
questions.explanation: 'Few' has a negative sense, so the question tag is positive: did they?

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: The officer continued the inspection _____ it was raining heavily.
questions.explanation: 'Although' introduces a contrast between the rain and continuing the inspection.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: No other district in the region is as densely populated as this one. Choose the correct comparative form.

options.A: This district is more densely populated than any other district in the region.
options.B: This district is most densely populated than all districts.
options.C: Any district is as densely populated as this one.
options.D: This district is less densely populated than other districts.

questions.explanation: The positive construction converts to comparative using 'more...than any other'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: The board objected to _____ the deadline without prior notice.
questions.explanation: In 'object to', the preposition 'to' is followed by a gerund.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Identify the part containing an error: 'One of the officers / have submitted / the revised statement / before noon.'
questions.explanation: The subject is 'one', which is singular; the verb should be 'has submitted'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Choose the best replacement for the phrase: 'The information are not sufficient to decide the case.'
questions.explanation: 'Information' is an uncountable singular noun and takes 'is'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Choose the word that best completes the sentence: The auditor found a _____ discrepancy between the two statements.
questions.explanation: A substantial discrepancy is a significant or considerable difference.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.

options.A: The officer said, 'Submit the file today.'
options.B: The officer said 'Submit the file today'.
options.C: The officer said, 'Submit the file today'.
options.D: The officer said 'Submit the file today.'

questions.explanation: The direct quotation is enclosed in quotation marks, and the full stop is placed inside the closing quotation mark in standard usage.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: There is _____ evidence to support the allegation; further inquiry is necessary.
questions.explanation: Evidence is uncountable; 'little evidence' means a small amount.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: The proposal, _____ was approved yesterday, will be implemented next month.
questions.explanation: A non-defining relative clause is set off by commas and uses 'which', not 'that'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: All visitors _____ display their identity cards at the entrance; it is compulsory.
questions.explanation: 'Must' expresses obligation or necessity.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Choose the correct collocation.
questions.explanation: The standard collocation is 'make a decision'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Choose the correct indirect form: 'The clerk asked me, “Where did you keep the register?”'

options.A: The clerk asked me where did I keep the register.
options.B: The clerk asked me where I had kept the register.
options.C: The clerk asked me where had I kept the register.
options.D: The clerk asked me where I keep the register?

questions.explanation: In indirect questions, use statement word order; past simple commonly backshifts to past perfect.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Read the statement: 'Although digitisation reduces processing time, its benefits depend on accurate data entry and regular system maintenance.' Which inference is best supported?

options.A: Digitisation automatically eliminates every administrative error.
options.B: Maintenance is unnecessary once a system is installed.
options.C: Technology alone cannot ensure efficient administration.
options.D: Accurate data entry increases processing time in every case.

questions.explanation: The statement makes efficiency conditional on data quality and maintenance, so technology alone is insufficient.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Choose the correct word: The committee reached a unanimous _____ after a lengthy discussion.
questions.explanation: The noun 'decision' is required after 'a unanimous'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.

options.D: She completed carefully the assignment careful.

questions.explanation: The adverb 'carefully' modifies the verb 'completed'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: The supervisor had the records _____ before the audit.
questions.explanation: The causative structure 'have + object + past participle' is used: had the records verified.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: In the sentence 'The instructions were ambiguous', the word 'ambiguous' means _____ .

options.A: open to more than one interpretation

questions.explanation: Ambiguous means unclear or capable of more than one interpretation.

questions.subject: General English
questions.question: Arrange the parts to form a coherent sentence: (P) before the deadline (Q) the applicant (R) submitted (S) all required documents.
questions.explanation: The correct order is: The applicant submitted all required documents before the deadline.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: What is the decimal equivalent of the binary number 101101?

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which type of memory retains its contents even when the power is switched off?
questions.explanation: ROM is non-volatile memory and retains stored contents without power.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which CPU component performs arithmetic operations and logical comparisons?
questions.explanation: The Arithmetic Logic Unit performs arithmetic calculations and logical operations.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In an operating system, a process waiting for an event such as completion of an I/O operation is generally in which state?
questions.explanation: A blocked or waiting process cannot proceed until the required event or I/O operation completes.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which file-system feature helps restore a consistent state after an unexpected system crash by recording pending changes?
questions.explanation: A journaling file system records intended changes so it can recover consistency after a crash.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In Windows, which keyboard shortcut opens Task Manager directly on most current versions?
questions.explanation: Ctrl + Shift + Esc opens Task Manager directly.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In a spreadsheet, which formula counts cells in B2:B20 that contain numeric values only?
questions.explanation: COUNT counts numeric cells; COUNTA counts all non-empty cells.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Cell D5 contains the formula =$B$2*C5. If it is copied to D6, what formula will appear?
questions.explanation: The absolute reference $B$2 remains fixed; the relative reference C5 shifts to C6.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which chart is generally most suitable for showing the trend of monthly expenditure over one year?
questions.explanation: A line chart is well suited to displaying trends over time.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which feature in a word processor is used to create personalised letters for many recipients using a common template and a data source?
questions.explanation: Mail Merge combines a main document with recipient data to produce personalised copies.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In presentation software, which view displays miniature slides for rearranging their order efficiently?
questions.explanation: Slide Sorter presents slide thumbnails and supports rapid reordering.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which protocol is primarily used to translate a domain name such as example.com into an IP address?
questions.explanation: DNS resolves domain names to IP addresses.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which protocol provides encrypted communication between a web browser and a website?
questions.explanation: HTTPS uses TLS to protect data exchanged between browser and server.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which of the following is a private IPv4 address?
questions.explanation: 172.16.0.0 to 172.31.255.255 is a private IPv4 range.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which device forwards packets between different IP networks using routing information?
questions.explanation: A router forwards packets between networks based on IP routing information.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In which topology does failure of a single central switch typically disrupt communication among all connected nodes?
questions.explanation: In a star topology, all nodes depend on the central hub or switch for communication.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which security mechanism requires a user to provide two different categories of evidence, such as a password and a one-time code?
questions.explanation: Two-factor authentication combines two distinct factor categories, commonly knowledge and possession.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: A malicious program that disguises itself as legitimate software and relies on the user to execute it is commonly called a _____ .
questions.explanation: A Trojan horse masquerades as legitimate software and is executed by the user.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: An email asks an employee to verify bank details through a look-alike website. This is primarily an example of _____ .
questions.explanation: Phishing uses deceptive messages and fake sites to steal sensitive information.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: What is the main purpose of a cryptographic hash function when storing passwords securely?

options.B: To create a fixed-length digest for verification
options.C: To transmit passwords in plain text

questions.explanation: A password hash produces a one-way digest used for verification; secure systems also use salts and suitable password-hashing algorithms.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which SQL clause is used to filter grouped records after the GROUP BY operation?
questions.explanation: HAVING filters groups after aggregation; WHERE filters rows before grouping.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: In a relational database, which key uniquely identifies each row in a table and cannot contain NULL values?
questions.explanation: A primary key uniquely identifies each record and must be unique and non-null.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which SQL command removes all rows from a table while retaining the table structure?
questions.explanation: TRUNCATE removes table rows while retaining the table definition.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which email protocol is commonly used by a client to send outgoing mail to a mail server?
questions.explanation: SMTP is used for sending outgoing email; POP3 and IMAP are used for retrieval/synchronisation.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: A user accesses a complete software application through a web browser while the provider manages the infrastructure and platform. This is best classified as _____ .
questions.explanation: Software as a Service delivers a ready-to-use application over the internet.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which storage device has no moving mechanical parts and generally offers lower access latency than a traditional hard disk drive?
questions.explanation: A solid-state drive uses flash memory and has no spinning platters or moving read/write heads.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which of the following is an example of an output device that produces a permanent hard copy?
questions.explanation: A plotter produces physical printed output, often for large technical drawings.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which backup strategy copies only data changed since the most recent full backup?
questions.explanation: A differential backup copies changes since the last full backup; an incremental backup copies changes since the last backup of any type.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which Wi-Fi security standard is generally considered the strongest among the following options for modern networks?
questions.explanation: WPA3 is the most recent and strongest option listed; WEP and older WPA modes are insecure.

questions.subject: Computer Knowledge
questions.question: Which file format is designed to preserve document layout across different devices and operating systems?
questions.explanation: PDF is designed to preserve page layout and formatting across platforms.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.question: 'ಅವನು ಪುಸ್ತಕವನ್ನು ಓದಿಯೇ ಮಲಗಿದನು' ಎಂಬ ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿನ 'ಓದಿಯೇ' ರೂಪವು ಯಾವ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಿಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: 'ಓದಿಯೇ' ಎಂಬ ರೂಪವು ಓದುವ ಕ್ರಿಯೆ ನೆರವೇರಿದ ನಂತರವೇ ಮಲಗಿದನು ಎಂಬ ಒತ್ತಿಹೇಳುವ ಅಥವಾ ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯತೆಯ ಭಾವವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
